title: Russian Strikes Kill Six in Dnipropetrovsk as Moscow and Kyiv Trade Economic-Infrastructure Attacks
detail: Russian strikes across Dnipropetrovsk region — hit more than 50 times — plus Kherson, Kharkiv (21 settlements), and Donetsk oblasts killed at least six people on August 7, as Moscow and Kyiv traded intensifying strikes on each other's economic and energy infrastructure. Ukraine's SBU said it struck a Wildberries logistics facility in Yekaterinburg, expanding its campaign against the Russian e-commerce giant to the Urals, and Ukrainian drones hit three FSB-linked vessels (Svetlyak, Balaklava, Kerch) in the Kerch Strait. Ukraine has struck roughly 20 Wildberries sites since mid-July, killing at least 13 people in Russia.

media.caption: Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk region kill six as Ukraine expands strikes on Wildberries
